end.summary:
Kavya described Diwali customs: new clothes, sweets, lamps, and puja.
They named Makar Sankranti and til laddoos as a festival food.
Harvest festivals and the season when crops are ready were practised.
The idea that festival dates are random remained at the end; the harvest-season link was not corrected after the last response.
end.parentNote: Asha practised describing festival food, clothes, decorations, and activities, and introduced the link between harvest festivals and crops becoming ready. Kavya gave clear details about Diwali and identified festival foods, including til laddoos. They were still mixing up festival dates with random choices and were unsure when wheat is ready. At home, look at a calendar together and discuss why Baisakhi or Makar Sankranti is connected with a particular season or harvest.
